entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... I hope you can help me. I need to return an item, and I'm just so disappointed. I feel awful about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's Steven Bell, order number VF45-8812. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and this is the first time I've had an issue. I really needed this to work out.

Thank you, Steven. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the ProFit Jersey. I understand this is frustrating. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. The **jersey** is the **wrong size**. I thought it would be okay, but when I finally put it on for a ride, it's just way **too tight** in the shoulders. I was hoping I could maybe get an **exchange** or just return it. I really needed that money back for some holiday expenses.
I see, thank you for clarifying that. It sounds like a sizing issue. Let me just check the purchase date and our return policy for you. One moment please.
Okay... I'm just really hoping you can help. I was counting on that.
Thank you for your patience, Steven. I've reviewed your order, and it looks like you are still within our 90-day return window. So, we can absolutely process that for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now that contains a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the item back up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive the jersey, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's perfect. You have no idea how much this helps. You've really made my day, Diana.
I'm so glad I could help, Steven. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
